auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Gupshup API key sent in the apikey header. Open the target app in https://www.gupshup.io/whatsapp/dashboard and copy the key from App Settings.

extraFields.label: App ID
extraFields.description: Gupshup WhatsApp app ID used for app-scoped template requests. Find it beside the API key in the target app's Settings page at https://www.gupshup.io/whatsapp/dashboard.

actions.name: list_templates
actions.description: List message templates for the connected Gupshup app.

pageNo.description: The zero-based page number to retrieve.

pageSize.description: The number of templates to return per page.

templateStatus.description: The template status to filter by, such as APPROVED.

templateCategory.description: The template category to filter by, such as MARKETING, UTILITY, or AUTHENTICATION.

templateType.description: The template type to filter by, such as TEXT.

quality.description: The template quality rating to filter by, such as GREEN.

languageCode.description: The template language code to filter by, such as en.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for listing templates in the connected Gupshup app.

appId.description: The Gupshup app ID that owns the template.

createdOn.description: The template creation timestamp in milliseconds.

modifiedOn.description: The template modification timestamp in milliseconds.

items.description: A Gupshup WhatsApp message template with provider-defined metadata.

templates.description: The templates returned for the connected app.

outputSchema.description: The template-list response returned by Gupshup.

actions.name: send_template_message
actions.description: Send an approved text template message through Gupshup.

source.description: The registered WhatsApp Business sender number in international format without a plus sign.

destination.description: The recipient WhatsApp number in international format without a plus sign.

appName.description: The Gupshup app name associated with the sender number.

templateId.description: The unique ID of the approved Gupshup template.

parameters.description: The template parameter values in their order of occurrence.

inputSchema.description: A Gupshup WhatsApp text template message.

status.description: The submission status returned by Gupshup.

actions.name: send_text_message
actions.description: Send a text message in an active WhatsApp conversation through Gupshup.

source.description: The registered WhatsApp Business sender number in international format without a plus sign.

destination.description: The recipient WhatsApp number in international format without a plus sign.

appName.description: The Gupshup app name associated with the sender number.

text.description: The text content to send to the recipient.

disablePreview.description: Whether to disable link previews in the text message.

status.description: The submission status returned by Gupshup.
